_meta.note: Re-judged after ADR-0018 (bucket scope narrowed to callable symbols) and ticket 11 (TS receiver typing). The previous list described the pre-narrowing bucket; 4 keys survive with sharper classes, 6 are new entries the narrower scope surfaced.

apps/repoqa-web/src/App.tsx:34.reason: App is rendered by main.tsx via createRoot(...).render(<StrictMode><App /></StrictMode>) and by App.test.tsx. Module-level JSX has no enclosing symbol to carry the edge (report §5 P1) — hence testOnly=true: only the test-file renders resolve.

apps/repoqa-web/src/App.tsx:129.reason: onKeyDown is passed as a JSX attribute value ({onKeyDown}) — an identifier reference, not a call expression; no call edge can exist.

apps/repoqa-web/src/brand-marks.ts:182.reason: brandColor has no production caller, but brand-marks.test.ts imports and calls it. Not dead code — an exported utility whose only consumer is its own test (test-only API smell, the class census.testOnly is meant to expose).

apps/repoqa-web/src/client/RepoQAClient..reason: RepoQAClient.getRepo has ZERO callers: `grep -rn '\.getRepo(' apps/repoqa-web/src` outside this file returns 0 hits; the only other occurrences are vi.fn() stubs in five test doubles (App/useInspector/useRepoCatalog/useDashboard/useTours tests) that exist for interface-shape completeness, plus the unrelated server-side RepoQARepos.getRepo (a different class). Dead frontend API — removal candidate.

pickFolder is called at App.tsx:156, but App's `client` comes from useMemo(() => clientProp ?? new RepoQAClient(...)) — the deep-NewExpression case (family f) stays dynamic, so the edge is not counted.

listReverseDeps is called at useReverseDeps.ts:18 as `(c, repoId_, name) => c.listReverseDeps(...)` — the callback parameter `c` is typed by the callee's signature (family e), which the adapter does not infer.
radar is called at EvolutionView.tsx:397 and CommandPalette.tsx:98; the receiver is typed `Pick<RepoQAClient, 'radar'>` (family g) — a utility-type annotation the adapter does not expand.
getArchitectureDelta is called at ArchitectureDeltaView.tsx:71 with the receiver typed `Pick<RepoQAClient, 'getArchitectureDelta'>` (family g).
runGate is called at CiGateView.tsx:237 with the receiver typed `Pick<RepoQAClient, 'runGate' | 'listGateRuns'>` (family g).
listGateRuns is called at CiGateView.tsx:159, same `Pick<...>` receiver (family g).
